flags.observation: 'sought software for rogue trading' drops the card's 'stop'; the meaning inverts and now accuses a named bank.
Opener 'But Wedge One's bookkeepers' ties the killed auditors to Woodford's falsified Navy records; no card makes that link, it lands on victims.
'due to loss' drops the accountants; the human loss turns ambiguous and can be heard as money lost.
'Wallet:' only echoes the card name; the line ends on a dangling 'Commission', so the card's claim about ignoring Ptech vanishes.
'twenty-four hours' is a bare power fragment; without its catastrophe context it reads as a leftover rule value.
'His question' plus 'why care?' blurs who asks; on the card the director asks Minnery, not Minnery himself.
'a long one' trails after 'event'; the scrambled word order breaks the quote's sense within one breath.
'biological warfare, genotypes' is a bare noun list; it reads like an index line, not a sayable claim.
'Yet the balance grows' repeats the 'Yet the' family four beats after beat 23; 'But the' also recurs at beats 6 and 13.
Openers 'Blueprint:', 'Wallet:', 'Paper:' are single labels without a so/but bridge; across all openers almost no artworkPrompt picture appears.
'A sealed ledger sits under a locked office door.' is a plain image; intro carries no satirical or provocative setup of the money trail.
Outro 'That sealed ledger remains beyond the office door.' restates the intro without a thought-provoking turn before 'Stay Fluffy!'.
